tools.name: check_fact
tools.description: Cost preflight before repeated paid or slow source-backed validation, especially across an agent fleet. Use before paid web search, metered scraping, browser/extraction, rate-limited APIs or multi-step validation when the caller already has a known value. Returns SAME_OBSERVED, CHANGED_OBSERVED, CON

tools.name: observe_fact
tools.description: After independently performing a source-backed validation, deposit the observed result for later CHECKs.
